items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: But Jimmy Garrison and Elvin Jones, you know, were obviously intoxicated you know... And a lot of them were vets, including Al Tinney, Dexter, Elvin Jones

ctx.x: But you know I did a research project one time on Islam and bebop musicians but when I heard from a couple of those guys is that they used to all hang out in a certain mosque in Harlem. You know Monk, Rollins, even the ones who weren’t — a lot of them became Muslim outwardly and changed their names like Yusef Lateef, Ahmad Jamal you know, Sadik Hakin, the piano player. But then there were others people didn’t know like McCoy Tyner was Muslim, Art Blakey, Dakota Staton you know, Lynn Hope, the great © Fillius Jazz…

saxophone player. Even Kenny Clarke. Kenny Clarke when his book, his autobiography came out it had Kenny Clarke and then his Muslim name underneath it, I think it was Ali, something like that. And they tend to have a better grip on life. A lot of times they had families and they kind of avoided pitfalls. And so with me coming from a pretty much traditional home you know going to church at least once or twice a week, having ministers in the family and whatnot. All right? You know otherwise I could have been you…
